posts.name: VisforYoshi
posts.cooked:
The end of my school semester is coming up, and it's also been almost a year since I bought Sentinels, and I wanted to say thank you all from the bottom of my heart.

This schoolyear has been one of the tougher one's I've had both educationally and mentally and I have to thank you guys for helping me go through it without going insane. Thanks to you guys, I have developed new hobbies and gotten into thing I thought I would never enjoy. And I have you guys and Sentinels to thank. I would have never become such a board game nerd without this game, and I probably would have stayed as a fairly toxic person who was almost always in a bad mood without you guys. So once again I want to say thank you, because all of you guys have helped me push through this semester. This is one of the best internet communities I have ever been a part of.

You guys are so awesome, and I'm incredibly grateful to be a part of this community
